research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Anduril Industries is researching autonomous defense platforms across air, maritime, and sensing domains. Counter drone system and modular system for detecting, tracking, and transmitting to identified objects describe networked RF and sensor architectures for detecting, localizing, and engaging targets. Aerial vehicle with deployable components and ruggedized autonomous helicopter platform cover reconfigurable UAV airframes and launch systems. Maritime vehicle systems and methods address autonomous underwater vehicles. Together these focus on autonomous sensing, targeting, vehicles, and launch.

overview_description.description: Anduril Industries designs and supplies autonomous defense systems and integrated software for security and military applications. The company develops an AI-driven command-and-control platform that links sensors, unmanned vehicles across air, land, and sea, and related hardware into a cohesive operational network. Its portfolio covers unmanned aerial vehicles, counter-drone technology, undersea autonomous vehicles, and autonomous ISR (intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance) platforms. Anduril also builds mission support software that helps users fuse sensor data and manage operations in real time. The company serves defense, national security, and government clients with technology solutions that emphasize autonomous operation and data integration.
